routes.label: descent to a genus-9 cover C/GF(p) of E/GF(p^6)
notes: existence of a cover over GF(p) of the priced genus is not established for this curve; odd-characteristic GHS and Diem's genus-3 covers need extra structure (for k = 3, rational 2-torsion is the usual precondition, recorded as an exact invariant)

priced at g = 9, the least genus of any GHS cover of E/GF(p^6) when F_p(j(E)) = GF(p^6) (research/odd_char_descent_genus3_20261014/); a GHS cover of genus 9 exists when j(E) is outside GF(p^3) and GF(p^2) (Joux–Vitse, Eurocrypt 2012, App. C).  Until 2026-10-15 the row was priced at g = 6, which no GHS cover has, and was boundary (-1.9 bits against rho).  A curve whose j lies in a proper subfield, or a non-GHS cover, could have a smaller genus, so the row is a lower bound on the GHS route only
